title: The write step rewrites links and kept pages the route stage renamed, writes brief phones as tel: links and heading emphasis as real tags, never keeps refused demo words silently; the site check never reads green on nothing checked and compares printed alts with what step 8 saw
steps: S1: From the checkout run the run command (write step and site check test files, one at a time).
S2: Read the result of each named test.
expect: AD, AE, P: a link written to an address the route stage renamed is rewritten to the new address, kept pages under a renamed parent are listed and measured at their live address, and an article page is renamed by its article alias.
AQ, AN: a brief phone number in a created page's words is a tel: link, and a created legal page prints through the kit's plain article layout.
J, AG: a site check group that checked nothing is not applicable with its reason or unmeasured, never green; a hide the contract has no slot for is blamed on step 0.

AH, AP, K, AL, AB: list-rows reads only the row's own block; a maps search map button is not refused; a slot printed as an image alt or title counts as printed; a rerun with the same files keeps removed slots; the look guard lets words replace social icons for a person with no account.
N, AS: heading emphasis is stored as real tags where the demo value is HTML, and a refused text slot never keeps demo words in silence.
Y: the site check's alt-matches-picture group blocks an alt that does not describe the picture step 8 placed, and is not applicable when no picture was written.
evidence: 06/11/2026, cards AD AE P AQ AN J AG AH AP K AL AB N AS Y from step 9 and step 11 bench runs on a sealed JA Boxing quickstart, merged into PR 415.
fence: Write step and site check on invented fixtures with fake door and page readers. Not exercised: a real site write, a real browser page read, the Postgres-backed bench.

tests: a url menu item and a link in a slot that name a moved address are written to the new one and read back
every way of writing a brief phone is wrapped once; other numbers and existing tel: links are left alone
a group that checked 0 with no reason is unmeasured, counted, and the verdict is not red
a group that checked 0 and says why is not applicable, printed with its reason, and keeps the verdict green
a slot whose demo value is HTML gets real tags; the ACM slot keeps its codes
the three rungs, each tried once: plain words, then hide, then a failed line naming the demo text
an alt that describes its picture agrees; one that names another scene blocks on that slot, blamed on step 6
